verdict.rationale: stagewise is built around a chat-driven agent. Users type natural-language requests, @mention files and tabs, or invoke skills with / slash commands, and the agent edits files, runs shell commands, drives browser tabs and orchestrates multi-step workflows. Community hands-on use confirms natural-language requests like "same height" are executed, though one produced a hardcoded 298px value rather than a solid CSS approach. Missing for 10: evidence that app-level settings and configuration can be operated via natural language (beyond coding/browser tasks), and stronger independent corroboration that commands produce reliable, high-quality results.
